messages:
alice: Quick one — hitting mypy errors from async client when the model sometimes returns a JSON object and sometimes a raw JSON string. Autogen pydantic types end up as Union[Dict[str, Any], str] and our async iterator wrapper loses the precise typing so it becomes AsyncIterator[Any]. Repro below.

alice: Example usage: 
```py
resp = await client.chat.completions.create(model=..., input=prompt)
# resp.output could be {'name': 'x'} or a JSON-string like '{"name":"x"}'
for item in resp.stream():
    # mypy: Item is 'Any', but I want 'Union[OutputModel, str]' 
    process(item)
```

ben: I ran into this too. The retry/decorator layer wraps callables as Callable[..., Any], so type info gets erased at the wrapper boundary. Seems to be two problems: codegen produces Union types and our runtime wrappers drop them.

carmen: Short-term workaround: cast the iterator: `for item in cast(AsyncIterator[Union[OutputModel, str]], resp.stream()):` but that's gross. Long-term: we should update generated client signatures to declare explicit AsyncIterator[Union[...]] and update retry decorator typing.

ben: Agreed. Also pyright flags it even if runtime is fine. Tests pass but typecheck fails in user code.

dinesh: Can you paste a minimal repro (file + mypy output)? I can look at the retry wrapper typings and the generated stub.

alice: Pasted gist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scratch-repros/typing-async-union (small script + mypy output). Repro is tiny.

carmen: For codegen change: instead of `Iterator[Any]` in stubs we generate `AsyncIterator[ModelOutput]` where ModelOutput = Union[SchemaA, str]. We also need an overload on create/stream so mypy can resolve chained calls.

dinesh: I think adding overloads for .create returning a typed response and for .stream returning AsyncIterator[ModelOutput] will help. Also update `retry` to be `def retry(f: Callable[P, T]) -> Callable[P, T]` using ParamSpec/TypeVar where we can. That should preserve type info.

ben: ParamSpec will require py3.10+ typing_extensions for older users though. We should document it in release notes.

ci-bot: ci/tests: 1 failing typecheck in devex tests — expected until PR lands.

alice: Plan: open issue and small PR with (1) update generated stub for stream typings, (2) typing ParamSpec change in retry wrapper, (3) add a unit mypy check in devex CI. I'll open the PR and tag you @dinesh for review.

carmen: Thanks — I'll review the stub template changes.

dinesh: Thanks, lemme know when PR is up and I'll run the runtime checks.
